# Vendored third-party code

## netgear_telnet_enable.py

The Netgear `telnetenable` magic-packet implementation, used by
`tools/orbi_telnet_enable.py` to unlock the router's telnet console.

- Author: B. Kerler
- Source: https://github.com/bkerler/netgear_telnet
- License: MIT (see [LICENSE](LICENSE) in this directory)

It is kept here, unmodified, so the tools work without a separate download.
Redistribution is allowed under the MIT license, with the copyright and
permission notice preserved (see `LICENSE`).
